tools.name: android.apk_endpoints
tools.description: Extract URL/domain/IP/content-URI endpoint candidates from parsed DEX strings across an APK with source DEX/string locators.

tools.name: android.apk_inventory
tools.description: Inventory APK ZIP members, DEX files, native libraries, certificates and manifest presence.

tools.name: android.apk_manifest
tools.description: Parse AndroidManifest.xml from an APK, including binary AXML, and summarize package, permissions, SDK and components.

tools.name: android.apk_search
tools.description: Search parsed DEX string tables inside an APK for a literal or regular expression.

tools.name: android.apk_signing_inventory
tools.description: Detect APK v1 signing entries and APK Signing Block scheme IDs (v2/v3/v3.1/source stamp) without modifying the APK.

tools.name: android.appdata_inventory
tools.description: Inventory an extracted Android app data directory (shared_prefs, databases, files, cache) without modifying it.

tools.name: android.dex_strings
tools.description: Parse the DEX string table using ULEB128 string_data_item and modified UTF-8.

tools.name: application.profile_apply
tools.description: Detect (or explicitly select) an application artifact profile for a SQLite database and normalise its rows into canonical fields. Opens the database read-only. When no profile matches, the tool reports that explicitly instead of guessing.

path.description: path to the application database (read-only evidence)

tools.name: application.profile_list
tools.description: List registered application artifact profiles (detection conditions, database locations, table/field mapping, time format, encoding, attachment relations).

tools.name: archive.extract_safe
tools.description: Extract ZIP/TAR members into a separate workspace with path-traversal, symlink/junction, member-count and total-size limits. Source archive is never modified. Each extracted member is registered as a DerivedArtifact so the recovery chain is provable.

tools.name: archive.inventory
tools.description: Inventory ZIP/TAR archive members and metadata without extraction. The member list is bounded by `limit` (peak memory stays proportional to `limit` even for very large archives).

tools.name: artifact.inspect
tools.description: Identify an artifact from magic bytes and container structure, with size and SHA-256.

tools.name: binary.compare
tools.description: Compare two files by fixed byte blocks, computing both SHA-256 digests in one streaming pass. Report changed block offsets/sizes and bounded previews; does not infer semantic equivalence or execute inputs.

tools.name: binary.elf_dynamic
tools.description: Parse ELF dynamic metadata: NEEDED libraries, interpreter, RPATH/RUNPATH, GNU build-id, and dynamic symbol table. Read-only.

tools.name: binary.elf_inventory
tools.description: Parse ELF architecture and section metadata; optionally extract bounded printable strings.

tools.name: binary.macho_inventory
tools.description: Inventory thin 32/64-bit and universal Mach-O headers, load commands, dylibs, rpaths, UUID, segments and bounded symbols without executing the sample. Code-signature presence is not cryptographic verification.

tools.name: binary.native_indicator_scan
tools.description: Heuristically scan a native binary for JNI names, crypto APIs, URLs and suspicious command/network indicators. Findings are indicators, not conclusions.

tools.name: binary.pe_exports
tools.description: Parse the PE export table: exported symbols with ordinals and addresses, plus forwarded exports. Read-only.

tools.name: binary.pe_headers
tools.description: Dump PE/COFF header structure: DOS/COFF/optional header fields, data directories and section summary. Read-only structural view.

tools.name: binary.pe_imports
tools.description: Parse the PE import table: DLLs and imported symbols (by name or ordinal). Computes Mandiant-compatible imphash. Read-only.

tools.name: binary.pe_inventory
tools.description: Parse PE/COFF architecture, timestamp, characteristics and section table without executing the binary.

tools.name: binary.pe_resources
tools.description: Walk the PE resource tree (type/name/language) and extract the embedded application manifest (RT_MANIFEST). Read-only.

tools.name: binary.pe_rich_header
tools.description: Decode the PE Rich Header: compiler/toolchain product IDs, versions and counts (linker, MASM, ImportLib). Read-only.

tools.name: binary.pe_signing
tools.description: Inspect Authenticode signature (WIN_CERTIFICATE / PKCS#7). Extracts embedded certificate chain issuer/subject/validity without external crypto libraries. Absence of a signature is reported, not assumed malicious.

tools.name: browser.chromium_bookmarks
tools.description: Read bounded Chromium Bookmarks JSON trees with folder paths, JSON-pointer locators and Windows-epoch microsecond timestamps; no browser launch or URL access.

tools.name: browser.chromium_cookies
tools.description: Inventory Chromium/Chrome/Edge Cookies SQLite metadata in immutable read-only mode. Plaintext values are omitted unless include_values=true; encrypted blobs are never decrypted.

tools.name: browser.chromium_downloads
tools.description: Read Chromium/Chrome/Edge download records and URL chains from History SQLite in immutable read-only mode.

tools.name: browser.chromium_history
tools.description: Read Chromium/Chrome/Edge History SQLite visits and URLs in immutable read-only mode.

tools.name: browser.chromium_search_terms
tools.description: Read recorded Chromium keyword_search_terms with URL context. URL last_visit_time is context, not an exact search timestamp; never inferred as a search event.

tools.name: browser.firefox_bookmarks
tools.description: Read Firefox moz_bookmarks joined to moz_places in immutable mode, preserving folder relationships, GUIDs and creation/modification timestamps.

tools.name: browser.firefox_cookies
tools.description: Read Firefox moz_cookies metadata in immutable read-only mode; redact plaintext values by default and normalize Unix second/microsecond timestamps.

tools.name: browser.firefox_history
tools.description: Read Firefox places.sqlite history visits in immutable read-only mode.

tools.name: case.report_html
tools.description: Render a self-contained HTML forensic report from a list of Observations: case summary, evidence sources, observations, recovered artifacts, timeline, entities, warnings/limitations, chain of custody and tool manifest. STATEFUL: writes only to the workspace; the report is registered as a DerivedArtifact.

output_dir.description: workspace directory to write the report into

audit_log.description: optional audit ledger to verify for chain of custody

tools.name: case.verify
tools.description: Verify an audit ledger's integrity and cross-check it against observations / a manifest. Validates the previous_hash → record_hash chain and re-derives each record's result and evidence digests. Reports VALID or BROKEN with the failing record number and reason.

audit_log.description: path to the JSONL audit ledger

observations.description: optional Observation.to_dict() list to cross-check against the ledger

tools.name: correlation.entity_graph
tools.description: Correlate domains, IPs, emails, SHA-256 values, and account identifiers across DFTK Observation JSON files or inline Observations, preserving source locators.

tools.name: crypto.bip39_scan
tools.description: Scan one file or directory for BIP39 English word sequences and distinguish checksum-valid mnemonics.

tools.name: crypto.bip39_validate
tools.description: Validate a BIP39 English mnemonic including its checksum.

tools.name: crypto.entropy_profile
tools.description: Compute bounded Shannon entropy per file block to highlight compressed/encrypted/high-entropy regions; does not classify encryption by itself.

tools.name: custody.ledger_verify
tools.description: Verify a DFTK chain-of-custody audit ledger (JSONL). Recomputes the per-record SHA-256 hash chain and reports records that were edited, deleted, reordered, truncated or downgraded, plus optionally compares the ledger against a seal written by 'dftk audit seal'. Verification is read-only. A status of ok means verification completed: read facts.verdict ('intact'/'legacy'/'partial'/'defective') and facts.chain_ok for the result — a negative integrity finding is an examination result, not a tool failure.

tools.name: database.sql_dump_inventory
tools.description: Inventory generic SQL text dumps (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite-style) for databases, CREATE TABLE statements and INSERT counts without importing the dump.

tools.name: database.sqlite_deleted_records
tools.description: Carve deleted/candidate records from SQLite unallocated page space, freeblocks and freelist pages. Classifies each as DELETED_CANDIDATE (column count matches the live schema) or CARVED (record-shaped but unmatched).

tools.name: database.sqlite_forensic_inventory
tools.description: Forensic inventory of a SQLite database: 100-byte header fields (page size, change counter, freelist, schema cookie, autovacuum, encoding, page count) plus a page-type distribution. Uses a direct byte parser, not the SQLite engine.

tools.name: database.sqlite_freelist
tools.description: Enumerate the SQLite freelist: the trunk chain and every freelist leaf page, comparing against the header total. Freelist pages hold dropped table/record data.

tools.name: database.sqlite_inventory
tools.description: Open SQLite in read-only URI mode and report objects, schemas and optional row counts.

tools.name: database.sqlite_pages
tools.description: Enumerate every page in a SQLite database with its type, cell count, freeblock and fragmented-byte metadata. Low-level structural map.

tools.name: database.sqlite_query
tools.description: Execute one bounded read-only SELECT/WITH query against SQLite with SQLite authorizer write operations denied.

tools.name: database.sqlite_recover
tools.description: Reconstruct only the last committed valid WAL snapshot; return bounded live storage records, heuristic deleted candidates, WAL diagnostics, and unsupported-table coverage. Source DB/WAL remain unchanged.

tools.name: database.sqlite_search
tools.description: Search bounded SQLite tables/columns for a literal value using immutable read-only access; avoids requiring the Agent to construct schema-specific SQL first.

tools.name: database.sqlite_wal
tools.description: Parse a SQLite WAL (-wal) file: header (magic, salts, checksums), and every frame with page number, commit flag, salt match and native-order checksum validity.

tools.name: docker.offline_inventory
tools.description: Recover Docker container configuration from an offline /var/lib/docker tree without starting Docker.

tools.name: docker.offline_logs
tools.description: Read bounded Docker json-file container logs from an offline Docker data root, optionally filtering for a literal query.

tools.name: email.auth_analyze
tools.description: Offline EML analysis of sender headers, DKIM identifiers and Authentication-Results. Header mismatches are context, not automatic spoofing verdicts.

tools.name: email.dkim_verify
tools.description: Verify DKIM signatures using dkimpy and DNS. This is signature verification, not DKIM-Signature repair.

tools.name: email.mime_inventory
tools.description: Parse an RFC-style email file and inventory headers, MIME parts and attachment hashes without extracting or executing content.

tools.name: email.spf_verify
tools.description: Evaluate SPF for a supplied sending IP and SMTP envelope identity using pyspf and DNS; it does not infer IP from From headers.

tools.name: encoding.decode_candidates
tools.description: Try common reversible text encodings (hex, Base64/Base64URL, percent-encoding) and return bounded decoded candidates with printable ratios.

tools.name: evidence.intake
tools.description: Create a bounded, read-only evidence intake manifest for a file or directory and return source-linked next DFTK calls for an Agent.

path.description: Evidence file or extracted evidence directory.

tools.name: file.hash
tools.description: Compute cryptographic hashes of one file without modifying it.

tools.name: file.search_tree
tools.description: Search a file or directory tree for text/byte patterns with bounded results and source locators.

tools.name: file.strings
tools.description: Extract bounded printable ASCII strings with byte offsets.

tools.name: file.strings_unicode
tools.description: Extract bounded UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE printable strings with byte offsets; useful for Windows/native artifacts that ASCII strings miss.

tools.name: filesystem.deleted
tools.description: List deleted file entries recovered from a filesystem. FAT volumes are recovered by the pure-Python reader; NTFS/ext unallocated recovery still requires pytsk3.

tools.name: filesystem.extract
tools.description: Extract a byte range (raw offset or, with pytsk3, a file path) from a disk image into the workspace. The extracted file is registered as a DerivedArtifact (provenance). STATEFUL: writes only to workspace.

tools.name: filesystem.list
tools.description: List the root (or given) directory of a filesystem inside a disk image. FAT volumes use the pure-Python reader (no external dependency); NTFS/ext/HFS+ still require pytsk3.

tools.name: filesystem.read
tools.description: Read a byte range from a filesystem. With a filesystem backend (pytsk3 for NTFS/ext/HFS+, or the pure-Python FAT reader) + path_in_fs, reads that file; otherwise reads partition_offset+offset raw bytes. Returns a bounded hex preview + SHA-256.

tools.name: filesystem.stat
tools.description: Return filesystem metadata (size, timestamps, type, attributes) for a file/dir inside a disk image. FAT uses the pure-Python reader; NTFS/ext/HFS+ need pytsk3.

tools.name: filesystem.walk
tools.description: Recursively walk a filesystem inside a disk image with depth/entry limits and optional deleted-entry inclusion. FAT uses the pure-Python reader; NTFS/ext/HFS+ need pytsk3.

tools.name: image.e01_filesystem_inventory
tools.description: Read E01/EWF through pyewf + pytsk3 and inventory volume partitions and bounded filesystem root entries without mounting or modifying evidence.

tools.name: image.e01_inventory
tools.description: Open an E01/EWF image read-only with pyewf and report segment/media metadata. Filesystem traversal is intentionally a separate future primitive.

tools.name: image.partitions
tools.description: Parse the partition table (MBR and GPT) of a disk image (raw dd or E01) without mounting or modifying it. Pure-Python parser.

tools.name: linux.auth_events
tools.description: Extract SSH authentication and sudo events from common offline Linux auth logs (including rotated gzip files).

tools.name: linux.offline_inventory
tools.description: Inventory a mounted/offline Linux root filesystem: OS release, accounts, package logs, web roots and Docker metadata presence.

tools.name: linux.package_events
tools.description: Extract package install/upgrade/remove events from common Debian/RPM/Pacman logs in an offline Linux root.

tools.name: linux.persistence_inventory
tools.description: Inventory common offline Linux persistence and operator-history locations: cron, systemd overrides, rc.local, SSH authorized_keys and shell histories.

tools.name: malware.yara_scan
tools.description: Scan one file or a bounded evidence tree with YARA rules using yara-python. Returns source hashes, rule metadata, and bounded match offsets; never executes or modifies scanned content.

path.description: File or extracted evidence tree to scan.

rule_file.description: YARA rule file under the authorized evidence root.

rule_text.description: Inline YARA rule source; do not combine with rule_file.

tools.name: memory.handles
tools.description: Run the fixed Volatility 3 plugin 'windows.handles' against a memory image and normalise the open handles into a structured Observation. No arbitrary Volatility args are exposed; the image is read-only evidence.

image.description: path to the memory dump (read-only evidence)

tools.name: memory.malfind
tools.description: Run the fixed Volatility 3 plugin 'windows.malfind' against a memory image and normalise the injected/ anomalous memory into a structured Observation. No arbitrary Volatility args are exposed; the image is read-only evidence.

image.description: path to the memory dump (read-only evidence)

tools.name: memory.modules
tools.description: Run the fixed Volatility 3 plugin 'windows.modules' against a memory image and normalise the kernel modules into a structured Observation. No arbitrary Volatility args are exposed; the image is read-only evidence.

image.description: path to the memory dump (read-only evidence)

tools.name: memory.network
tools.description: Run the fixed Volatility 3 plugin 'windows.netscan' against a memory image and normalise the network connections into a structured Observation. No arbitrary Volatility args are exposed; the image is read-only evidence.

image.description: path to the memory dump (read-only evidence)

tools.name: memory.processes
tools.description: Run the fixed Volatility 3 plugin 'windows.pslist' against a memory image and normalise the process list into a structured Observation. No arbitrary Volatility args are exposed; the image is read-only evidence.

image.description: path to the memory dump (read-only evidence)

tools.name: memory.volatility_inventory
tools.description: Run the fixed Volatility 3 plugin 'windows.info' against a memory image and normalise the system overview into a structured Observation. No arbitrary Volatility args are exposed; the image is read-only evidence.

image.description: path to the memory dump (read-only evidence)

tools.name: network.capture_protocols
tools.description: Extract bounded DNS questions, plaintext HTTP requests and TLS ClientHello SNI from classic PCAP or PCAPNG.

tools.name: network.dns_transactions
tools.description: Correlate DNS query and response messages by transaction id and question name, resolving A/AAAA/CNAME answers to their queried names. READ_ONLY.

tools.name: network.flows
tools.description: Group captured packets into network flows (TCP conversations and UDP 5-tuples) with packet/byte counts, timestamps and TCP flag summary, without external libraries.

tools.name: network.http_sessions
tools.description: Reassemble TCP streams and correlate HTTP request/response pairs. When a response body is a file-like object (by content-type or magic), it is extracted to the workspace and registered as a DerivedArtifact, forming the PCAP -> download -> binary analysis chain. STATEFUL: writes only to the workspace.

tools.name: network.pcap_inventory
tools.description: Parse classic PCAP packet headers and summarize IPv4 TCP/UDP endpoint tuples without external libraries.

tools.name: network.pcapng_inventory
tools.description: Parse PCAPNG interface and enhanced/simple packet blocks and summarize Ethernet IPv4 TCP/UDP flows.

tools.name: network.tcp_reassemble
tools.description: Reassemble TCP streams from a capture: per direction it overlays segments by sequence number (handling retransmission, out-of-order and overlap) and emits a hash + bounded hex preview of the logical byte stream. READ_ONLY: the evidence file is never written.

tools.name: network.tls_inventory
tools.description: Inventory TLS ClientHello records from a capture: SNI, ALPN, record/client version, supported versions, cipher suites, extensions and a JA3 fingerprint (MD5). READ_ONLY.

tools.name: recipe.agent.guided_intake
tools.description: Agent-first bounded first response: create an evidence intake manifest, then execute a small deterministic subset of its read-only evidence-derived routes. Returns executed and deferred actions for review.

objective.description: Optional investigation objective used only to prioritize matching route names/reasons.

tools.name: recipe.android.appdata_triage
tools.description: Inventory extracted Android app data and inspect discovered SQLite databases read-only.

tools.name: recipe.android.deep_static_triage
tools.description: Compose APK inventory, binary manifest parsing, signing scheme inventory and targeted DEX searches.

tools.name: recipe.android.static_triage
tools.description: Compose APK inventory with targeted DEX searches for URLs, crypto API names and storage/network indicators.

tools.name: recipe.artifact.auto_triage
tools.description: Deterministic first-pass routing by artifact magic. This is a convenience baseline; an Agent may choose deeper primitives based on the question.

tools.name: recipe.browser.history_triage
tools.description: Identify a browser history database and try Chromium and Firefox history parsers read-only.

tools.name: recipe.database.triage
tools.description: Identify and inventory SQLite databases or SQL text dumps without writes/imports.

tools.name: recipe.email.full_offline_triage
tools.description: Compose MIME/attachment inventory with offline authentication-context analysis; no DNS/network lookup.

tools.name: recipe.email.offline_triage
tools.description: Run offline email authentication-context extraction without DNS or remote lookups.

tools.name: recipe.network.capture_triage
tools.description: Auto-triage classic PCAP or PCAPNG and extract DNS, HTTP and TLS SNI observations.

tools.name: recipe.server.deep_offline_triage
tools.description: Compose offline Linux inventory, package/auth/persistence, Docker metadata/logs and web configuration/access-log discovery.

tools.name: recipe.server.offline_triage
tools.description: Compose offline Linux, package-history, Docker and web-config discovery for a mounted server root.

tools.name: recipe.timeline.unified
tools.description: Build a unified, source-attributed timeline from a filesystem evidence tree and optional extra dftk Observation sources.

extra_sources.description: Optional paths to dftk Observation JSON files to merge in

tools.name: recipe.wallet.mnemonic_scan
tools.description: Scan an extracted evidence tree for checksum-valid BIP39 English mnemonics.

tools.name: recipe.windows.offline_triage
tools.description: Compose offline Windows artifact triage from a SYSTEM Registry hive and/or EVTX file.

tools.name: server.readonly_inventory
tools.description: Run a fixed read-only inventory set over SSH. No arbitrary command parameter is exposed.

tools.name: server.remote_snapshot
tools.description: Collect a fixed, bounded, read-only SSH forensic snapshot. Profiles cover baseline host inventory, incident-response state, containers, or web exposure; arbitrary shell commands are never accepted.

tools.name: timeline.file_metadata
tools.description: Create a bounded filesystem metadata timeline from an extracted evidence tree.

tools.name: timeline.hunt_sequences
tools.description: Find bounded ordered event chains across forensic timelines using exact-field rules and shared entity fields. Returns source-linked investigative leads, explicit coverage limits, and no automatic compromise verdict.

steps.description: Ordered exact-field selectors (AND fields; array values mean OR; dotted paths supported).

group_by.description: Shared entity fields required in every step, such as host and user; missing values never join.

within_seconds.description: Inclusive first-to-last time window; step timestamps must strictly increase.

tools.name: timeline.merge
tools.description: Merge time-bearing events from multiple dftk tool outputs or inline sources into one normalized, source-attributed timeline. Inputs are read-only; nothing is modified.

files.description: Paths to dftk Observation JSON files (each should contain facts.events)

inline.description: Inline sources: {"source": label, "events": [...]} bundles or flat events with a 'source' key

tools.name: tree.inventory
tools.description: Bounded inventory of an extracted evidence directory: file counts, extensions, total size and largest files.

tools.name: web.access_log_summary
tools.description: Summarize common Nginx/Apache access logs in an offline tree: clients, methods, status codes and requested URIs.

tools.name: web.config_candidates
tools.description: Discover likely web/application configuration files under an offline directory; optionally extract key names while redacting values.

tools.name: web.config_extract
tools.description: Parse one explicit configuration file and return key/value structure. Secret-like values are redacted unless include_values=true.

tools.name: web.webshell_hunt
tools.description: Scan an extracted web/application tree for source-linked suspicious execution, request-input, obfuscation, and process-launch pattern combinations. Scores are triage leads, not malware verdicts.

tools.name: windows.amcache
tools.description: Parse Amcache.hve (pure-Python REGF reader) for program/file evidence: file paths, SHA1 hashes, sizes, versions, last-modified timestamps, and the linked ProgramId. Also extracts InventoryApplication program metadata.

tools.name: windows.evtx_hunt
tools.description: Parse EVTX records into a source-linked timeline and flag high-value Windows security, PowerShell, service, scheduled-task, and Sysmon event classes. Hits are triage leads, not verdicts.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter across normalized event fields.

tools.name: windows.evtx_summary
tools.description: Summarize EVTX providers, event IDs and timestamps using python-evtx when installed.

tools.name: windows.lnk
tools.description: Parse a Windows Shell Link (.lnk) shortcut with pure-Python parsing: recover the target path, file attributes, creation/access/write timestamps, and TrackerDataBlock (machine id / MAC).

tools.name: windows.mft
tools.description: Parse an NTFS $MFT file with pure-Python parsing: recover file/directory paths, Standard Information and $FILE_NAME timestamps, record flags and sizes. Best-effort full-path reconstruction via parent references.

tools.name: windows.prefetch
tools.description: Parse a Windows Prefetch file (.pf, versions 17/23/26/30) with pure-Python parsing: recover the executable path, prefetch hash, run count and last-run time(s), and the set of referenced files.

tools.name: windows.recyclebin
tools.description: Parse Windows Recycle Bin $I metadata files (Windows 10+): recover the original deleted file name, size and deletion time, and detect the paired $R data file when present.

tools.name: windows.registry_deleted_keys
tools.description: Recover deleted/unreachable key nodes (nk) from a Windows Registry hive using DFTK's pure-Python parser. Deleted keys remain in the hive as free/unlinked cells; we walk the live tree to learn reachable cells, then scan every cell for an nk signature that is free or unreachable. No external dependency.

tools.name: windows.registry_inventory
tools.description: Inventory a Windows Registry hive using python-registry when installed; never modifies the hive.

tools.name: windows.registry_tree
tools.description: Parse a Windows Registry hive (REGF) with DFTK's pure-Python parser and return the live key tree (names, LastWrite timestamps, values). No external dependency.

tools.name: windows.shimcache
tools.description: Parse the AppCompatCache (Shimcache) registry blob. Extracts per-entry file paths and last-modified timestamps. Execution is explicitly NOT inferred (execution_inference='unsupported'); correlate with Prefetch/Amcache/MFT/USN.

path.description: raw Shimcache blob (.bin) or a registry hive containing the value

is_hive.description: set True if 'path' is a SYSTEM hive to extract the value from

tools.name: windows.srum
tools.description: Parse SRUDB.dat (ESE database) for application/network resource usage. Requires pyesedb (python-libesedb); returns UNSUPPORTED when unavailable. Extracts the well-known usage tables with application, SID, timestamps, and byte/packet counters. Column types and raw bytes are retained; dates are not guessed from byte length.

tools.name: windows.usb_artifacts
tools.description: Extract USBSTOR and MountedDevices artifacts from an offline SYSTEM Registry hive.

tools.name: windows.usnjrnl
tools.description: Parse an NTFS $UsnJrnl $J change-journal stream (pure-Python): recover USN records with File Reference Numbers, timestamps, reason codes, source info and file attributes. Optionally resolves FRNs to full NTFS paths via a provided $MFT. Reports file-system activity factually; it does NOT infer program execution (correlate with Prefetch/Amcache/MFT instead).

path.description: Path to the extracted $J stream file

mft_path.description: Optional $MFT file to resolve FRNs to full paths

reason_filter.description: Only include records whose reason set intersects these names (e.g. FILE_CREATE, RENAME_NEW_NAME, CLOSE)
